Triaged by the `domain:ui` PM seat: `finding` · `domain:ui` · `pm:queue` · `plugin: charts` · `priority:p3`.

**p3 rather than p2, for consistency rather than severity.** This is the fourth card carved out of the same chart-series measurement, and the other three sit at p3: #7690 (the axis-config object dialect), #7694 (`chartType` silently stripped), #7682 (`variant` drift across four sites). Grading this one higher would say the family is ordered by which card happened to be measured last. If a maintainer reads the family as a whole and wants it lifted, lift all four together.

**The card's own framing is right and should be preserved through dispatch:** the published declaration in PR #7684 is correct — both keys are spec members and both are live on a comparison series — and the gap is the renderer honouring a spec-declared unconditional override on one variant only. ⛔ Do not open this as "narrow the mirror". That would be the renderer's tolerance dictating the contract, which is the direction `AGENTS.md` #0.1 forbids, and the card says so itself.

⚠️ Read-coupling to declare at dispatch: **PR #7684 is in flight and touches the declaration of both keys.** Its docs now state the comparison-only condition as an interim measure. Whoever takes this card must re-read #7684's landed state first — if the renderer is fixed here, that interim wording becomes wrong and must come out in the same change (objectui#7070: restated, not left to rot).

## Correction to this card's body — the mechanism, and a split between the two keys

From the `domain:ui` PM seat, raised by the contract review of PR #7684 (comment to follow on that PR) and then **re-measured by me directly** on `origin/main` before posting, because this corrects a claim in a card body.

### What the body says

> All five call sites (`:1825`, `:1892`, `:2035`, `:2046`, `:2054`) apply `cmp?.fillOpacity` / `cmp?.strokeOpacity` / `cmp?.strokeDasharray`

They do not all apply all three. Read from `packages/plugin-charts/src/AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` on `main`:

| mark | what it passes |
| :-- | :-- |
| Scatter `:1832` | `fillOpacity` **only** |
| Bar `:1911` | `fillOpacity` **only** |
| Bar `:2037` | `fillOpacity` **only** |
| Area `:2056` | `fillOpacity`, `strokeOpacity`, **and** `strokeDasharray` |

### The mechanism is one step further down than either the body or the review put it

The review attributed it to `comparisonStyle` "setting `strokeDasharray` to `undefined` for those kinds". That is only the **fallback** half. `:96` reads:

```ts
const strokeDasharray = s.dashArray ?? (kind === 'line' || kind === 'area' ? '4 4' : undefined);
```

When the author *writes* `dashArray`, the `??` left side is taken and `comparisonStyle` returns the authored value **for every kind, bar included**. What drops it is the **mark component**: Bar and Scatter never pass `strokeDasharray` (or `strokeOpacity`) through at all. Same outcome, different owner — and it matters, because a fix aimed at `comparisonStyle` would not repair it.

### This splits the two keys, which the body treats as one case

- **`opacity`** — reaches `fillOpacity`, which **every** mark applies. So on a comparison series it is live on bar, scatter, line and area. Its only condition is the one the body names: `variant: 'comparison'`.
- **`dashArray`** — reaches only `strokeDasharray`, which **only line and area** apply. So its condition is comparison **and** line/area. `strokeOpacity` is in the same position.

So the card's headline is right for `opacity` and **understates** the gap for `dashArray`.

⚠️ Whoever implements option A here inherits both: making the keys honoured unconditionally means touching the mark components, not just the `variant` guard. Re-measure before starting — this reading is from `main` at the time of writing and the file is under active change.

⛔ The disposition is unchanged: this is a **renderer** finding. The published declaration in PR #7684 is right (the spec declares both keys unconditionally), and narrowing the mirror to match a partial renderer is the direction `AGENTS.md` #0.1 forbids.

What changes is the **renderer honouring** what is already declared: authored keys that were read-and-discarded start taking effect. Same shape as objectui#7687 (the combobox `disabled` read), which was correctly judged a behaviour change and ⛔ not an accept-set change. ⚠️ If your own measurement contradicts that, ⛔ stop and report.

**⛔ THE CARD'S BODY IS WRONG ABOUT THE MECHANISM. Read comment 5550238143 before you read the body.** That correction was re-measured directly on `main` by the seat that raised it, and it relocates the defect:

The body says all five call sites apply `fillOpacity` / `strokeOpacity` / `strokeDasharray`. **They do not:**

| mark | what it actually passes |
| :-- | :-- |
| Scatter `:1832` | `fillOpacity` **only** |
| Bar `:1911` | `fillOpacity` **only** |
| Bar `:2037` | `fillOpacity` **only** |
| Area `:2056` | `fillOpacity`, `strokeOpacity` **and** `strokeDasharray` |

And `comparisonStyle:96` is `s.dashArray ?? (kind === 'line' || kind === 'area' ? '4 4' : undefined)` — so when an author **writes** `dashArray`, the `??` left side is taken and `comparisonStyle` returns the authored value **for every kind, bar included**. ⇒ **what drops it is the MARK COMPONENT, not the `variant` guard.**

⭐ **This is the load-bearing consequence: a fix aimed at `comparisonStyle` would not repair `dashArray` at all.** The card points at the wrong place.

**⇒ the two keys have DIFFERENT conditions, which the body treats as one case:**
- **`opacity`** → `fillOpacity`, which **every** mark applies. Its only condition is `variant: 'comparison'`. The card's headline is right for this key.
- **`dashArray`** → `strokeDasharray`, which **only line and area** apply. Its condition is comparison **AND** line/area. The card **understates** this gap. `strokeOpacity` is in the same position.

⇒ implementing option A means **touching the mark components**, not just the `variant` guard. ⚠️ That correction is from `main` at the time it was written and the file is under active change — **re-measure before starting**; ⛔ do not carry those line numbers forward as tree facts.

## Zone 1 — ADJUDICATION (binding)

- ✅ **Option A** is the route: honour the authored `opacity` / `dashArray` **regardless of `variant`**, and keep the comparison-specific **DEFAULTS** (muted opacity, `4 4` dash) gated on `variant === 'comparison'`. Existing comparison series are unaffected (the override branch already wins over the defaults); the new effect is only where an author wrote the key on a primary series and got nothing.
- ⛔ **NEVER narrow the mirror or the docs to 「comparison only」.** That is the renderer's tolerance dictating the contract — the direction **AGENTS.md #0.1** forbids. The spec is the contract of record and describes both keys as unconditional. Triage restated this as binding; the card says it of itself.
- ⛔ **Option B is NOT yours to take.** It is a `@objectstack/spec` change in another repo, and only if the maintainer rules the keys comparison-by-design. If your measurement leads you there, ⛔ stop and report rather than acting.
- ✅ **Read-coupling, binding:** PR #7684 landed and its docs state the comparison-only condition as an **interim** measure. If the renderer is fixed here, that wording becomes **wrong and must come out in the same change** — objectui#7070's rule: restated, ⛔ not left to rot. Re-read #7684's landed state first.
- ⛔ Do not fold in **#7690**, **#7694**, **#7682** (the `variant` union drift these reads sit beside) or **#7546**. Same measurement family, separate cards.

## Zone 2 — PM MECHANISM ASSUMPTIONS (falsify freely)

I have **not** independently re-measured this card — the correction above is the previous seat's reading, not mine, and I am handing it to you as the better starting point rather than as fact. ⛔ Verify the mark-component table, the `??` behaviour at `comparisonStyle:96`, and which marks apply `strokeDasharray` / `strokeOpacity`, with your own lit control. The card's own census control (the grep finding the five `cmp?.…` sites and the two `normalizeSeries` reads) is a reasonable instrument to rebuild.

## Zone 3 — SUGGESTED ROUTE (advisory)

Pin per the card: a primary-series `opacity: 0.3` reaches the mark's `fillOpacity` / `strokeOpacity`; a comparison series with **no** keys keeps its muted defaults (`ChartRenderer.specSeries.test.tsx` harness). ⚠️ Extend that to `dashArray` across **bar and scatter**, not only line/area — otherwise the pin passes while the key this card is most wrong about stays broken.

Serial constraints cleared: `packages/plugin-charts/**` is named by no other slot in this wave. ⚠️ `packages/core/src/utils/chart-presentation.ts` is on the dataset path — if you must touch it, say so; it is not held by another slot but it is outside `plugin-charts`. The queue arbitrates.
